title: Windows: escape the literal ! in cutout.bat's success message
paragraphs: With setlocal enabledelayedexpansion active, cmd.exe treats a lone trailing "!" as an unmatched delayed-expansion marker and silently drops it, so "Background removal complete!" printed without the "!". This only surfaced once CI got past the dependency-test fix and ran the real launcher tests on windows-latest. Escaping it as ^^! (the standard workaround for a literal "!" under delayed expansion) keeps the message and matches what tests/test_launchers.py asserts.

title: Fix CI: reset stale $LASTEXITCODE after deps test harness's negative case
paragraphs: test-deps.ps1's final test intentionally makes deps.ps1 throw by leaving the fake pip install's $LASTEXITCODE at 1. Every Assert passed and the script printed PASS, but GitHub Actions' pwsh shell exits a step using $LASTEXITCODE when it's left set, so the leftover 1 from that negative test failed the "Dependency setup tests" step even though the test itself succeeded. Reset $LASTEXITCODE to 0 once all assertions pass.
Reproduced locally with `pwsh -command ". 'tests/test-deps.ps1'"`, matching the exit-code propagation GitHub Actions uses for pwsh steps.
